meta.notes: Trained on NSE intraday. Bias correction applied after discovering 0% bullish accuracy in early samples.

rules.name: MA alignment trend
rules.source: How to Make Money in Intraday Trading
rules.entry: Buy pullback to 20MA with bullish confirmation candle

rules.name: MA alignment bearish stack
rules.source: How to Make Money in Intraday Trading
rules.entry: Sell rally into falling 20MA with bearish candle

rules.name: Lower high structure = default bearish
rules.source: ARGUS training — Bharat Bijlee, Axis, Bajaj Finance
rules.condition: Three or more lower highs on 15m chart regardless of price being near support
rules.entry: Short below most recent lower high confirmation
rules.notes: CRITICAL — overrides support bounce assumption. Lower highs = bearish until structure breaks.

rules.name: Support is NOT a buy signal
rules.condition: Price at support level without higher-low structure, breakout above resistance, or volume confirmation
rules.entry: Do not enter. Wait for one of: higher low formed, resistance reclaimed, volume confirmation
rules.notes: Support repeatedly tested becomes weaker. Third/fourth retest = breakdown probability increases.

rules.name: Rejection candle reversal
rules.condition: Long wick candle with small body. Wick > 2x body size.
rules.entry: Bullish rejection (long lower wick): Buy above confirmation candle. Bearish rejection (long upper wick): Sell below confirmation candle.

rules.name: Giant candle momentum
rules.condition: Candle body 2x+ larger than average of last 5 candles. Indicates institutional participation.
rules.entry: Bullish giant: Buy above high. Bearish giant: Sell below low.

rules.name: Lilliput breakout
rules.source: Intraday book — XXS candle volatility contraction
rules.condition: 3+ consecutive tiny candles much smaller than surrounding candles. Volatility contraction before expansion.
rules.entry: Buy above range high. Sell below range low.

rules.name: Breakdown-weak retest short
rules.condition: Price breaks support with volume. Then bounces weakly. Buyers fail to reclaim prior structure. Lower highs still intact after bounce.
rules.entry: Short on failed retest. Entry below retest high.
rules.notes: One of the strongest NSE setups. Reliance showed this cleanly.

rules.name: Exhaustion reversal — never short extended decline
rules.source: ARGUS training — Muthoot Finance bear trap
rules.condition: Stock already down 3%+ intraday. Volume expanding at lows. Candles losing downside momentum.
rules.entry: Reduce bearish confidence. Look for stabilization + explosive reclaim before shorting.
rules.stop: N/A — rule reduces confidence, not a direct entry signal
rules.notes: Reversal checklist: (1) significant prior decline? (2) volume spike at lows? (3) candles slowing? If all yes — WAIT.

rules.name: Extended stock penalty
rules.condition: Stock already moved >10% in current session or >20% in last 3 sessions.
rules.entry: Do not chase. Wait for consolidation first. Reduce confidence by 15-20 points.
rules.notes: Distribution volume at top looks like continuation volume. Do not be fooled.

rules.name: Market tailwind alignment
rules.condition: NIFTY up >1% — only look for longs. NIFTY down >1% — only look for shorts. Stock diverging from NIFTY direction = strong signal in divergence direction.
rules.entry: Never short against a strong bull day unless stock shows clear relative weakness.
rules.notes: TVS was up because NIFTY was up, not because of its own strength. Always check relative strength.

rules.name: Two 15m candle confirmation
rules.source: ARGUS training — ICICI Bank live trade
rules.condition: After 9:15 AM open, never enter in first 15 minutes. Wait for first 2 x 15m candles to close.
rules.entry: Enter only after 9:45 AM if: both candles green, price holds above key level, no large red wick on candle 2.
rules.notes: Pure timing rule. Not directional. Prevents getting caught in 9:15-9:30 operator manipulation.

RELIANCE.notes: Relief rallies fail. Lower high structure very reliable.

ICICIBANK.notes: V-recovery in strong market works. Tight spread, liquid.

BBJEE.notes: Low liquidity — spreads wide, moves fast. Misread distribution as accumulation once.

PHARMA.note: Sector rotates out on strong bank days. Check NIFTY PHARMA vs NIFTY BANK divergence.

BANKING.note: Leads on RBI news days and broad market up-days.

NBFC.note: Volatile. Follow Bajaj Finance as sector proxy.
